notes.title: Rescuties! VR 1.07 - Halloween! 🎃👻👶
notes.notes:
* A spooky Rescuties time with vampire babies!  Ghost babies!  Zombie babies! 
* Catch bonus jack-o-lanterns before they smash on the ground!
* Various tweaks, fixes, and framerate upgrades.
* (Note: you can turn off seasonal events like Halloween!)
